"Go on."
"It's not about power. It's about — someone has to decide, and I'd rather it be someone who'll lose sleep over it."
"I’m listening."
"I watch how people look at you. Some of them are waiting for an alternative. I'm just saying."
"Tell me more."
"Power's a trap. Responsibility's a duty. I know the difference."
"I’m listening."
"I don't need to be followed. I need us to not wander in circles."
"Tell me more."
"If I don't step up, someone worse will. That's not ambition, that's arithmetic."
"I should go. You know where to find me."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"I asked Naomi about the pantry run — Naomi's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Tell me why you need this."
"Another day like today and we're choosing who eats. Meet me at the old burn east of camp and we'll fill packs before dark."
"I’ll come back to help."
"Wait — I'm out on the road. I can't ask you to meet me at dawn when I'm miles away. Find me when I'm back, and we'll set it then."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Still on that foraging help."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Still on that foraging help. That's still where we are."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Like I said — Still on that foraging help."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"As I said — Still on that foraging help."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"I've told you three times now — Still on that foraging help."
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I can't reach this properly. Will you help me clean it?"
"Tell me why you need this."
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
"I’ll come back to help."
"Careful with it. And — thank you."
"Teach me something from the wild."
"There's more, but that's for another fire."

"Come find me when you have a moment."

"Go on."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. Anyway."
"That it's intentional. That someone's watching and this is all... on purpose."
They go quiet. "Yeah. Me too. The randomness would almost be kinder."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"The way I read it — Still on what scares you most."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"Here's what I think — Still on what scares you most. That's still where we are."

"Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!"
"You're a good listener, you know that?" A tired smile.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? Anyway, I should move."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
"All right. Let's go."
"I buried this before the Scattering. Seemed stupid to keep it secret." Arijit digs up a wrapped bundle — food, still good. (+866 kcal to the pantry.)
"Hey — you alright?"
"Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."
"How are you holding up? About... them."
"Netsanet is gone, Aaliyah is gone, and Katarina is gone. The fire doesn't care. That's what gets me — the fire doesn't care."
"Want to come with us?"
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"Want to come with us?"
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"Gotta run. Literally. Bye!"
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
"This was good." They mean it.
"You said the scary part is this might be on purpose. That someone's watching. Believing it more or less these days?"
